senses.sense_definition: Iemand die beroepsmatig werkzaam is in de bouwsector.

examples.text: De <w>bouwvakker</w> draagt altijd een veiligheidshelm op de bouwplaats.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>construction worker</w> always wears a safety helmet on the construction site.

examples.text: Elke <w>bouwvakker</w> werkt hard aan de nieuwe huizen in de wijk.

target_lang_translations.en: Every <w>construction worker</w> is working hard on the new houses in the neighborhood.

target_lang_definitions.en: A person who is professionally employed in the construction industry.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The most common and standard term for someone working on a construction site.
A general term for someone employed in the building trade.
